title: Task completion can prematurely end dispatch
description: An empty task ledger does not mean the parent’s follow-up turn has finished. If a task notification arrives before the original result, this branch returns immediately, leaving the injected continuation unread. I reproduced this: the first dispatch returned “Waiting for report.”; the next dispatch discarded “Wrote artifact.” as leftover text. Artifact validation can therefore run before the artifact is written. Track pending continuations/session completion separately and test this message ordering.

title: Model switching bypasses the unusable-session guard
description: DispatchAction calls `set_model()` before `dispatch()`, but only the latter checks `unusable_reason`. After a failed reconnect, a subsequent step with a concrete model reaches the disconnected client instead of reporting the recorded failure. I verified it raises `CLIConnectionError: Not connected. Call connect() first.`, losing the original reconnect diagnosis. Guard `set_model()` too, and cover this through the real action path.

title: Background-session changes lack required load coverage
description: The new tests exercise short scripted streams, but no load test covers sustained background notifications, concurrent activity, or bounded cleanup latency. The existing `tests/load/` tests cover grep and worktrees only. Add a realistic session-stream load test asserting latency or resource bounds, as required for changes on network/concurrency paths.

title: Task completion can return before the parent continuation
description: A task notification arriving before the original result clears the active ledger, causing dispatch to return without reading the parent’s queued continuation. Reproduced with `ScriptedClient`: dispatch returned `"Waiting"` after one receive call, leaving `"Finished artifact"` unread. Track pending continuations separately from running tasks and add this ordering as a regression test.

title: Background timeout interrupts active foreground continuations
description: The timeout selected before reading a continuation remains active throughout that turn, even after its task-completion notification clears the ledger. Reproduced a continuation that emitted `"Working"` then paused: dispatch returned partial text without its final result, logging a timeout with no tasks to stop. Disable the background-only timer when foreground continuation begins.

title: Settings lookup and SDK execution target different directories
description: Configuration is resolved against the supplied `cwd`, but SDK agents receive `cwd=None` and execute in the process directory. When these differ, one project’s memory/user-settings policy controls a session loading another project’s settings and memory. Use one effective directory for configuration and SDK execution, or reject mismatched directories explicitly.

title: Background timeout accepts invalid durations
description: The timeout is not validated as a positive, non-boolean integer. Verified that `0`, `-1`, `False`, and `True` all pass the current read path. Nonpositive values can immediately cancel waiting and stop healthy agents; booleans become zero/one-second limits. Reject these values at the configuration boundary and test both CLI and TOML inputs.
